articles.title: Foreign Investors Turn Buyers in Indian IT Stocks for First Time in 2026
articles.excerpt: FPIs invested ₹3,358 crore in the sector during July as better-than-expected earnings eased AI disruption fears, part of a broader ₹20,200 crore inflow that snapped a four-month selling streak.
articles.image_caption: Foreign portfolio investors invested ₹3,358 crore in Indian IT stocks during July 2026, their first net purchase in the sector this year. The broader FPI inflow into Indian equities reached ₹20,200 crore, snapping a four-month selling streak.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors and tech professionals track FPI flows as a key indicator for Indian market health and IT sector valuations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
